equation_summary: Threshold Rectified Attention: out = (ReLU(Q@K^T - tau))^p @ V, NOT softmax. tau(i) = beta * sqrt(2*log(i+1)/d) is a position-dependent threshold; causal mask zeroes j>i before the threshold. Differential variant: optionally L2-normalize q1,k1,q2,k2 (cosine), compute two threshold-relu paths out1,out2, then out = out1 - clamp(lambda,0,1)*out2. No normalization denominator at all — the reducer is the threshold-ReLU-power nonlinearity applied to the score, then a plain @V contraction.
